title: data for billing.invoice_past_due
description: An invoice is past due and unpaid: the subscription becomes past_due. After grace_until, new sends answer 402 SUBSCRIPTION_PAST_DUE until the invoice is paid; inbound messages, delivery events and webhooks never stop. Envelope business_id and channel_id are null.

kind.description: subscription = monthly fee of the cycle; seat_addition = prorated seats added mid-cycle; overage = messages above the allowance (only with a published price and the integrator's authorization).

total_micros.description: Invoice total. Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

grace_until.description: End of the grace period; new sends are blocked from then on.
